snippet.title: The Journey Home Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600820/The_Journey_Home/

The Journey Home is an atmospheric platformer written by bestselling author Sophie Leigh-Robbins, and a new trailer for the game aired during the Future Games Show at gamescom 2026. It's coming soon to PC, with a demo available now on Steam.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
